skill.name: momentic-test
skill.description: Create, run, and maintain Momentic browser E2E tests and modules stored as *.test.yaml and *.module.yaml files.
skill.summary: Create, validate, and maintain Momentic browser tests and reusable modules.
skill.author: momentic-ai

security_audit.summary: All 59 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, documentation links, relative-path guidance, or ordinary product terminology. One low-severity semantic finding covers scoped host resource inspection; no malicious intent, prompt injection, or executable payload was found.

remediation.issue: Host troubleshooting may inspect CPU, memory, and process metadata beyond the project.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval before host inspection and limit collected process details to data needed for the active test failure.

content.value_statement: Browser tests can become fragile when steps, timing, and reusable flows are handled inconsistently. This skill guides structured Momentic authoring, validation, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Creates and updates Momentic v2 test and module YAML files.
Guides interactive test development through Momentic MCP sessions.
Previews, saves, and validates browser test steps in logical checkpoints.
Selects native, AI Action, JavaScript, and module steps for specific needs.
Preserves relative references, cache identifiers, environment values, and nearby file conventions.
Diagnoses timing, targeting, browser resource, format, and data failures.
limitations: Requires an existing Momentic project and available Momentic tools.
Does not directly edit deprecated v1 YAML files.
Cannot guarantee application stability, network availability, or browser resource capacity.
Requires user approval before actions with costly or non-idempotent effects.

use_cases.title: Create a Browser Test
use_cases.description: Build a new v2 test from a user-visible goal and validate its smallest useful range.

use_cases.title: Repair a Failing Flow
use_cases.description: Inspect screenshots, timing, cache behavior, and prerequisites before making a focused test change.

use_cases.title: Standardize Reusable Modules
use_cases.description: Find repeated flows, evaluate module reuse, and preserve parameters and references across a test suite.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Momentic v2 test for [user goal]. Use [base URL] and verify [success condition]. Ask before any side effect.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a simple browser test with clear success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Update [test file or ID] so it covers [changed behavior]. Preserve existing structure and validate the smallest affected range.
prompt_templates.scenario: Adapt a test after an application change.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose [failing test or step]. Review the latest screenshot, prerequisites, timing, cache, and resources. Make only evidence-based changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigate a test that fails or targets the wrong element.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Test Suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [test scope] for repeated flows and fragile patterns. Recommend module reuse, targeted assertions, and validation steps without weakening coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve maintainability across several Momentic tests.

output_examples.input: Create a login test that confirms the dashboard appears.
output_examples.output: Created a v2 login test with credential entry, submission, and a dashboard visibility check. Validated the changed range in one session.

output_examples.input: Fix a checkout test that intermittently misses the confirmation page.
output_examples.output: The submission completed before the confirmation state became stable. Added a focused URL check and preserved the existing checkout steps.

output_examples.input: Reduce duplicated setup across account tests.
output: Identified a repeated four-step account setup flow.
Recommended a reusable module with explicit inputs.
Listed affected references and validation ranges.

best_practices: Confirm the goal, starting state, environment, and success criteria before editing.
Preview logical checkpoints and validate the smallest saved range covering the change.
Use native Momentic steps and focused assertions before adding JavaScript or broad AI actions.
anti_patterns: Do not weaken assertions or add sleeps to hide application failures.
Do not run purchase, delete, send, or submission actions without explicit approval.
Do not edit shared modules or deprecated v1 YAML directly.

faq.question: Which Momentic files does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports v2 test YAML and module YAML files, plus related configuration and references.

faq.question: Can it work with deprecated v1 tests?
faq.answer: Yes, through Momentic persistence tools. It should not edit v1 YAML directly.

faq.question: Does it run complete test suites automatically?
faq.answer: It prefers the smallest relevant range. Expensive full runs require a clear need or user approval.

faq.question: How does it handle risky browser actions?
faq.answer: It requests approval before non-idempotent actions and executes an approved action at most once.

faq.question: When should JavaScript be used?
faq.answer: Use it for setup, external services, data generation, or browser state that native Momentic steps cannot express.

faq.question: How does it troubleshoot intermittent failures?
faq.answer: It checks prerequisites, screenshots, timing, cache behavior, browser state, and host resource pressure before changing the test.
